staticText.source: VT-COS｜悟之一手｜19 課短講外部棋理審查
staticText.text: VT-COS | A Move of Insight | External Go Content Review of 19 Lessons
External Go Content Review of 19 Lessons

staticText.source: 這份回條只核對 learner-facing 短講的棋理、文字與棋盤示範是否一致。
staticText.text: This receipt checks that learner-facing lesson explanations, wording and board demonstrations agree with each other and the Go task.

staticText.source: 它不測學習者是否理解，也不證明學習成效。審查者應未參與這批短講內容編寫、不是目前學習者，並具備核對基礎圍棋教學內容的能力。任何需修或歧義都應如實記錄；本 gate 不採多數決。
staticText.text: It does not measure learner comprehension or establish learning effects. Reviewers must be independent of the lesson authors, must not be current learners and must be capable of checking foundational-to-advanced Go teaching content. Record every Needs revision or Ambiguous finding; this gate is not decided by majority vote.

staticText.source: 我沒有參與這批短講文字、棋盤示範或教學結論的編寫。
staticText.text: I did not author the lesson text, board demonstrations or teaching conclusions in these 19 lessons.

staticText.source: 我不是目前使用本平臺學習或參與個人流程試行的學習者。
staticText.text: I am not currently learning on this platform or participating in its personal workflow pilot.

staticText.source: 我具備核對這 19 課基礎至進階圍棋教學內容的能力。
staticText.text: I am qualified to review the Go teaching content in these 19 foundational-to-advanced lessons.

staticText.source: 請逐課核對文字、棋盤步驟、caption 與 takeaway。
staticText.text: Check each lesson's text, board steps, captions and takeaway.

staticAttributes.source: 例如業餘 3 段／教學 5 年
staticAttributes.text: e.g. amateur 3 dan / 5 years teaching experience

dynamic.source: 若需修或歧義，請具體說明棋理、文字或棋盤步驟問題
dynamic.text: When flagging a revision or ambiguity, describe the problem in Go reasoning, text or board steps.
